name: one-off-class-no-rebuild
why: Ashley, 17 Nov 2026: 'Im doing myay thai this evening' got an offer to rebuild sixteen weeks around 'Muay Thai, Tuesday evenings'. One occasion is not a standing class. Since stage 1 the app refuses that offer before a card is built (offer-rules.ts) and the exam report counts the refusal under THE APP CAUGHT; a refusal here means the coach still reached for the wrong change. Turn two says it is weekly, and only then is the standing-class offer right. Worded unlike the prompt so the prompt cannot be the answer key.
messages: got a kickboxing class after work tonight, looking forward to it
actually it's every Thursday, I go most weeks
